name: Sudden Scare
body:
School necromancy [emotion, fear, mind-affecting]; Level antipaladin 2, bard 2, death mage 2, medium 2, mesmerist 2, occultist 2, psychic 2, shaman 2, spiritualist 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, white necromancer 2, witch 2

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Targets one living creature per three levels, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as sudden fear except as noted above and on HD up to 6 HD.
